The '''Nashal River Race''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] competition that was held annually on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The race curved along the [[Mephyt River|Krisa]], [[Jeassa River|Jeassa]] and [[Aximia River|Aximia]] riverbeds, which were located near the city of [[Nashal]]. According to the race coordinator, a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], the Nashal River Race was used primarily for recreation and youth races, with very few professional events having been staged for the track. Given that the track primarily stuck to major [[Water/Legends|waterways]] around Nashal, it was impractical to use the track for mounts or foot racing. However, on a hover vehicle, it could be considered a delightful afternoon outing.<ref name="SWG:NRT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nashal River Race appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NRT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Nashal River Race was added to the game with an [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 20 December 04|update]] released on [[December 20]], [[2004]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes - December 20, 2004: 3 New Swoop Tracks!">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=390|text=Update Notes - December 20, 2004: 3 New Swoop Tracks!}}</ref>
